prerequisites: Attended the course of "Fondamenti di Informatica I e Lab."
Good knowledge of the C programming language

learning_outcomes.text: To introduce the basic concepts of structured programming, the methodological aspects of programming and algorithm correctness and complexity.
The lectures will provide the student with the ability to know and understand the computer science fundamentals and the imperative and sequential programming.
Through the practical lessons in the laboratory, the student will be able to define sequential algorithms and to develop and test programs using the C language.
The student will be able to design and implement complex computer applications in C language.
The student will be able to communicate ideas, problems, and complex computer solutions.
The student will have a basic understanding that will allow subsequent searches on topics related to software programming and analysis of complex data structures.

syllabus_topics: Rules of visibility and duration of variables and functions
Evaluation of the complexity of programs
Binary and Search Trees (BST): insertion, search, deletion
Dictionaries: management and implementation with Lists, BSTs, and Heaps
Exercises on all topics covered in class
Design and implementation of structured programs in C language
teaching_methods: Assisted exercises in the teaching laboratory
assessment_rules: Learning is verified through a multiple-choice test (1 hour) in preparation for a second practical computer test (2 hours). The first test assesses knowledge, while the computer test assesses the ability to create algorithms in C language. For the first test, no notes, books, or other material may be consulted; for the second test, theory books, C reference, documentation, and primitive function implementations provided during the exam may be used, but not notes or exercise books. There are no intermediate tests.
